query: Consider Euler Hermes's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document allow the Receiving Party to acquire information similar to the Confidential Information from a third party?
gold:
3. Notwithstanding markings or representations regarding confidentiality, it is specifically agreed that Euler Hermes shall have no obligation with respect to any part of the Confidential Information:
b. received by Euler Hermes at any time from any source other than the Company that has no obligation regarding the confidentiality of the information;
rag_answer:
Yes. Under the Euler Hermes NDA, the Receiving Party (Euler Hermes) is expressly allowed to receive information from a third party in certain circumstances.

Specifically, Paragraph 3(b) states that Euler Hermes has no confidentiality obligation with respect to any part of the Confidential Information if it is:

> “received by Euler Hermes at any time from any source other than the Company that has no obligation regarding the confidentiality of the information.”

It also states that Euler Hermes has no obligation for information received as public information under Paragraph 3(c).

So, the document effectively permits Euler Hermes to acquire the same or similar information from a third party, provided that the third party has no confidentiality obligation and the information is not otherwise restricted.

judge.gold_summary: Euler Hermes 对保密信息无义务，如果其从公司以外来源获得该信息，且该来源不受保密义务约束。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答引用 Paragraph 3(b)，说明 Euler Hermes 从公司以外且无保密义务的来源获得信息时不受保密义务约束，并据此认为允许从第三方获取相同或类似信息。
judge.reason: 系统回答准确覆盖了金标关键条款和结论，即第三方来源且无保密义务时可不受 NDA 约束；额外提及公开信息不影响命中。
